newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha demand slack, prices drift lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha demand slack, prices drift lower.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices eased $2-3 per tonne pressured by weaker crude on Tuesday as demand across Europe stayed thin.
Traders said interest for parrafinic grades was muted with most petrochemicals running down stocks for the year end while weakening gasoline prices dulled demand for reforming naphtha.
Recently supportive North American buying had thinned with higher freight costs limiting arbitrage profitability.
Spot cargoes were notionally valued around $226.50 a tonne cif NWE.
